Maruti Suzuki launches automatic CNG variants of Dzire, Baleno, Swift

Maruti Suzuki announced the launch of automatic S‑CNG versions of its Dzire, Baleno and Swift models. The new variants use compressed natural gas as fuel and are equipped with automatic transmissions. Maruti stated that the CNG models will achieve a mileage of 36.47 kilometres per kilogram of CNG. The launch was reported by both English‑language and Hindi‑language media outlets. No details on pricing, availability dates or sales targets were provided in the coverage.
